test_cases.name: Activate a home internet gateway on a new account end to end with an eligible address
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
HINT (T-Mobile Home Internet) lets a Metro rep activate a fixed-wireless home internet gateway. When the rep enters a gateway IMEI, the platform classifies the device as Home Internet (dbo.HintDevices ItemId lookup / Metro type 'INT'), confirms the device with the rep, collects the customer's service address, checks it against the HomeInternetEligibilityCheck service, and — if covered — requires a dual customer + retailer acknowledgement before the flow continues to SIM, plan, and payment. The activity order is ValidateDevice → ValidateHint → ResolveDevicePricing → ValidateSimCard. A false-positive eligibility means a gateway that will not provision (chargeback + churn); a false-negative loses a $50/mo home internet sale.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2008 (HINT Epic), RTPL-2289 (FE device validation + address eligibility), RTPL-2416 (blank screen after IMEI — regression guard), RTPL-1889 (BE eligibility)

## Preconditions
- ConfigCat flag enable_subscriber_activation_hint is ON for the store (backend-mock equivalent: subscriber_activation_hint_enabled=true).
- Rep signed in at a COR store; no activation in progress.

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **HINT gateway IMEI:** 999977129737997 (known HINT gateway on QA/UAT; backend-mock equivalent 390100000000101)
- **EID:** First unused EID from the env fixture pool (dualSims.eid) — gateways are eSIM
- **Eligible service address:** 31455 NORTHWESTERN HWY, FARMINGTON, MI 48334 (known covered/unlimited address; backend-mock ZIP switch 33101)

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- Backend-mock equivalents: HINT IMEIs are the 39-prefix seed series (hotspot 390100000000101, router 390200000000202); eligibility outcome is driven by ZIP switches — 33101 eligible, 33102 ineligible, 33103 limited, 33104 service error, 00000 invalid address.
- The accept-hint-consent action chains resolve-device-pricing server-side — the client lands directly on validate-sim-card; assert the SIM header, not an intermediate pricing screen.
- Step order oracle: ValidateDevice → ValidateHint → ResolveDevicePricing → ValidateSimCard (SubscriberActivationProcessConfiguration).
- Cite-worthy regression: RTPL-2416 shipped a missing routing entry that produced a blank screen after IMEI — the SIM-validation-header assertion after consent is the guard.

steps.expected: [Both] POST validate-identity returns state.businessData.completion.eKey. [FE] Success text "Congratulations, your customer's ID has been verified." Cart account panel shows Account type "New account", ID verified ref# = eKey.

steps.action: On IMEI validation, rep enters the HINT gateway IMEI and continues
steps.expected: [BE] POST validate-device classifies the device as Home Internet (deviceType HomeInternet / Metro type 'INT' / dbo.HintDevices ItemId hit); state.processId captured. [FE] Non-dismissable drawer "Confirm home internet device" opens with message "The IMEI entered is a home internet device and requires extra details to activate. Click continue to proceed with activating this home internet device."

steps.action: Rep clicks Continue on the confirm-device drawer
steps.expected: [FE] Drawer closes; panel "Home internet address eligibility" is shown with note "Confirm the customer's address where the device will be located to check for service eligibility then click continue to proceed with activating this home internet device." Breadcrumb reads "HINT Eligibility"; cart step chip reads "Home internet eligibility".

steps.action: Rep types the 5-digit service ZIP code
steps.expected: [FE] ZIP field is masked to 5 numeric digits (99999). City and state auto-populate from the ZIP lookup (city UPPERCASE, state code selected); fields are disabled during the lookup and editable after.

steps.action: Rep enters address line 1 (and optional line 2) of the service address
steps.expected: [FE] Address line 1 accepts 2-30 characters, line 2 up to 15, city up to 40 — all forced UPPERCASE; state is a US-state select. Continue enabled once required fields are valid. No screen change.

steps.action: Rep clicks Continue to submit the address for the eligibility check
steps.expected: [Both] POST .../activities/validate-hint with action 'provide-hint-address' and the uppercased address/city/state/zipCode returns 200 with reasonCode 'hint-consent-required', availableActions ['accept-hint-consent','decline-hint-consent'] and a non-empty eligibilityId stored on the line. [FE] Drawer "Home internet acknowledgement" opens: "Good news - 5G home internet is available.", the submitted address for review, section "Customer acknowledgement" ("I acknowledge the home internet gateway (fixed-wireless device) is approved to be used ONLY at the address approved for eligibility. Use outside of the approved address will result in impacts to your service.") and section "Retailer acknowledgement" ("I confirm I informed the customer that the home internet gateway cannot be used at an address different from the one approved for eligibility. Use outside of the approved address will result in impacts to their service."). Continue is disabled.

steps.action: Rep checks the customer acknowledgement and the retailer acknowledgement
steps.expected: [FE] Both checkboxes checked; Continue becomes enabled. No screen change.

steps.action: Rep clicks Continue on the acknowledgement drawer
steps.expected: [Both] validate-hint action 'accept-hint-consent' completes; device pricing resolves and currentActivity advances to 'validate-sim-card'. [FE] SIM validation header appears — never a blank screen (regression guard for the missing HINT routing entry).

steps.action: Rep completes SIM validation with the gateway's EID and continues
steps.expected: [FE] eSIM card "IMEI 2 - ESIM" with EID input. [Both] POST validate-sim-card returns state.lines[0]; GET available-mdns returns the MDN list; Phone number selection header appears. [FE] Cart: SIM card row present, Total due updated.

steps.action: Rep keeps "New phone number" and continues
steps.expected: [FE] "New phone number" card checked. [Both] GET selection-options/protections returns protectionPlans. [FE] Protection selection header; cart Phone number row = (npa) nxx-****.

steps.expected: [Both] POST configure-protection; GET selection-options/plans returns the plan list. [FE] Plan selection header appears.

steps.action: Rep reviews Plan selection and continues with the pre-selected plan
steps.expected: [BE] The offers request for this line carried ispCategoryList = [the plan category captured from the eligibility response] — plans returned are Home Internet plans only. [FE] Plan cards shown (count = plans.length, index 0 pre-selected, rate badge "$x per month"). [Both] POST configure-plan; GET selection-options/promotions. [FE] Cart gains Plan (SOC) = $x / mo.

steps.expected: [FE] Promotion selection header; if none eligible, exact text "This customer is not eligible for any promotions at this time. You can continue with the current pricing." [Both] POST configure-promotions; GET selection-options/addons.

steps.action: Rep continues past Add on services and confirms Create subscriber
steps.expected: [FE] "Add on services" header with category tabs. On Continue, the create-subscriber confirm dialog appears; rep clicks "Create subscriber" then "Continue to order summary". [BE] Before activation the platform re-verifies the HINT location — accepted statuses 'success'/'VERIFIED' only — and the Metro activation payload carries subscriberAddressDetails built from the eligibility request.

steps.action: Rep reviews the Order Summary
steps.expected: [FE] Order summary rows: Order ID = state.orderId, Account number, Lines in order = 1, Total MRC, Total taxes & fees, Edge due immediately.

steps.action: Rep passes through Add Accessory without adding an accessory
steps.expected: [FE] "Review invoice" header; line-item rows with Discount / Tax / PP Tax totals and Balance due = payment.totalAmount. [Both] Continue to payment fires POST prepare-payment.

steps.action: Rep collects the exact balance due in cash and completes the payment
steps.expected: [FE] Payment summary shows "Order summary" + "Account summary"; Total to collect = balance due (+ fee if any). [Both] collect-cash → collect-payment succeeds. [BE] SaleRecord persists with a real record number (no 'TEMP-' prefix).

test_cases.name: Recover from a non-covered address by trying a different address on the same line
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
When the home internet eligibility check returns not-eligible for the submitted service address, the platform must tell the rep clearly and let them correct the address without losing the line or restarting the activation. The dialog (reworked under RTPL-2565) offers "Try a different address" — which reopens the address form via the retry-hint-address action — and "Remove this line". A rep who cannot correct a typo'd address loses the sale.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2289 (AC-5), RTPL-2565 (Address not eligible dialog), RTPL-1889 (BE eligibility)

## Preconditions
- enable_subscriber_activation_hint ON.
- New activation in progress: HINT gateway IMEI validated and the confirm-device drawer accepted; rep is on the "Home internet address eligibility" panel.

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **HINT gateway IMEI:** 999977129737997 (backend-mock: 390100000000101)
- **Ineligible service address:** 100 RURAL ROUTE 1, KETCHIKAN, AK 99901 (known not-covered; backend-mock ZIP switch 33102)
- **Eligible service address:** 31455 NORTHWESTERN HWY, FARMINGTON, MI 48334 (backend-mock ZIP 33101)

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- retry-hint-address clears both eligibilityId and the stored hintAddress server-side — assert the second submission carries the NEW address, not a merge of both.
- Errors surface as auto-dismissing top-right toasts on this platform — capture dialog/toast assertions synchronously on the response.

steps.action: Rep enters the ineligible service address and clicks Continue
steps.expected: [Both] validate-hint 'provide-hint-address' returns 200 with reasonCode 'hint-address-not-eligible' and availableActions ['retry-hint-address','decline-hint-address']; the line's eligibilityId is cleared. [FE] Confirm dialog "Address not eligible" appears with message "This address isn't eligible for home internet service. Try a different address, or remove this line and keep the rest of the order." and buttons "Try a different address" / "Remove this line".

steps.action: Rep clicks "Try a different address"
steps.expected: [Both] validate-hint action 'retry-hint-address' resets the HINT stage. [FE] The "Home internet address eligibility" form is shown again; the activation is NOT cancelled and the flow does not restart.

steps.action: Rep enters the eligible service address and clicks Continue
steps.expected: [Both] 'provide-hint-address' returns 200 'hint-consent-required' with a fresh non-empty eligibilityId. [FE] The "Home internet acknowledgement" drawer opens ("Good news - 5G home internet is available.") — a fresh coverage check ran against the corrected address.

test_cases.name: Remove an ineligible home internet line from a multi-line order and keep the paid lines
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
Before RTPL-2565, failing the address eligibility check on a multi-line order dumped the rep at the add-line screen with generic buttons, and reps abandoned whole transactions. Now "Remove this line" on the "Address not eligible" dialog cancels only the HINT line and routes the rep straight to Order Summary with the remaining, already-activated lines intact — protecting the rest of the sale.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2565 (GTM: remove HINT line routes to Order Summary), RTPL-2410 (multi-line HINT order)

## Preconditions
- enable_subscriber_activation_hint ON.
- New account with a phone line fully activated (through activate-subscriber), then add-line started with a HINT gateway: IMEI validated, confirm-device drawer accepted, address form open.

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **Phone IMEI (line 1):** First unused IMEI from the env fixture pool (singleSims)
- **SIM (line 1):** Matching pooled ICCID
- **HINT gateway IMEI (line 2):** 999977129737997 (backend-mock: 390100000000101)
- **Ineligible service address:** 100 RURAL ROUTE 1, KETCHIKAN, AK 99901 (backend-mock ZIP 33102)

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- The Order Summary routing only applies when at least one line has completed activate-subscriber (declineOverride handleRemoveHintLine → viewOrderSummary). A sole HINT line takes the add-line fallback instead — covered by the sibling case.
- Assert cart/Order Summary line count and the surviving line's totals — the regression mode is the HINT cancel wiping sibling-line state.

steps.action: On the HINT line's address form, rep enters the ineligible service address and clicks Continue
steps.expected: [Both] 'provide-hint-address' returns 200 'hint-address-not-eligible'. [FE] Dialog "Address not eligible" with buttons "Try a different address" / "Remove this line".

steps.action: Rep clicks "Remove this line"
steps.expected: [Both] The HINT line is cancelled (cancel-line) and the order completes to review. [FE] Rep lands directly on Order Summary — NOT the add-line screen. Order Summary shows only the activated phone line (Lines in order = 1); the phone line's pricing is unchanged.

test_cases.name: Remove a sole ineligible home internet line and fall back to adding a new line
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
When the only line in the order is the HINT line and its address fails eligibility, "Remove this line" cannot land on an Order Summary (there is nothing left to summarize). The flow must fall back to the add-line path so the rep can start a different device cleanly. This exact branch was flagged as NOT live-tested during RTPL-2565 verification, making it the highest-value unexplored path of that fix.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2565 (AC3 — sole-line fallback, flagged QA gap)

## Preconditions
- enable_subscriber_activation_hint ON.
- New account created and ID verified; the FIRST line started with a HINT gateway IMEI; confirm-device accepted; address form open. No other lines exist.

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **HINT gateway IMEI:** 999977129737997 (backend-mock: 390100000000101)
- **Ineligible service address:** 100 RURAL ROUTE 1, KETCHIKAN, AK 99901 (backend-mock ZIP 33102)

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- This is the RTPL-2565 AC3 branch that was never live-verified — treat unexpected routing here as a product bug, not a test bug.
- Assert no leaked HINT state on the replacement line: breadcrumb must not read "HINT Eligibility".

steps.action: Rep enters the ineligible service address and clicks Continue
steps.expected: [Both] 'provide-hint-address' returns 200 'hint-address-not-eligible'. [FE] Dialog "Address not eligible" with "Try a different address" / "Remove this line".

steps.action: Rep clicks "Remove this line"
steps.expected: [Both] The HINT line is cancelled. [FE] Because no other line has been activated, the rep is returned to the add-line / device entry flow — not an empty Order Summary, not a dead-end, and the account context (account number, verified ID) is preserved.

steps.action: Rep enters a standard phone IMEI from the fixture pool to start a replacement line
steps.expected: [Both] POST validate-device succeeds for the phone. [FE] Flow proceeds to the phone's normal next step with no residual HINT state (no HINT breadcrumb, no address form).

test_cases.name: Add a home internet gateway as a second line after activating a phone on the same new account
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
The canonical mixed order: a handset activates as line 1, then the rep adds a HINT gateway as line 2 on the same new account. Historically this threw an "activity sequence error" on Continue/Add New Line/Order Summary (RTPL-2410, release-blocking) because the handset flow and the HINT add-line flow conflicted in the process state machine. The eligibility identifier for the new account comes from the identifier chain (IDV-captured phone → line-assigned MDN in cart → account number). Both lines must reach one shared Order Summary and a single cash payment.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2410 (activity sequence error on multi-line — release-blocking), RTPL-2630 (eligibility with voice line in cart), RTPL-2008 (Epic)

## Preconditions
- enable_subscriber_activation_hint ON.
- New account created, ID verified; phone line 1 completed through activate-subscriber (device → SIM → new number → plan chain done).

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **Phone IMEI (line 1):** First unused IMEI from the env fixture pool (singleSims)
- **SIM (line 1):** Matching pooled ICCID
- **HINT gateway IMEI (line 2):** 999977129737997 (backend-mock: 390100000000101)
- **EID (line 2):** First unused pooled EID
- **Eligible service address:** 31455 NORTHWESTERN HWY, FARMINGTON, MI 48334 (backend-mock ZIP 33101)

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- RTPL-2410 was marked Ready for QA with no code change located in any repo — if the activity-sequence error reproduces at Add New Line, Continue, or Order Summary, file it against RTPL-2410 rather than debugging the test.
- Repro variant from the original bug skipped protection on the HINT line — this case preserves that (protection skipped).
- The acceptance harness models this exact scenario (HintEligibility.feature: iPhone line then home internet line, ISP category asserted on the offers request).

steps.action: Rep clicks Add New Line after the phone line completes activation
steps.expected: [Both] add-line succeeds — no activity-sequence error. [FE] IMEI validation opens for line 2.

steps.action: Rep enters the HINT gateway IMEI
steps.expected: [BE] validate-device classifies HomeInternet. [FE] "Confirm home internet device" drawer opens.

steps.action: Rep confirms the device, submits the eligible service address, and accepts both acknowledgements
steps.expected: [Both] 'provide-hint-address' returns 'hint-consent-required' (the voice line already in the cart supplies the eligibility identifier — no MDN-unavailable error); 'accept-hint-consent' advances to validate-sim-card. [FE] SIM validation header for line 2 — no activity-sequence error at any step.

steps.action: Rep completes SIM (EID), keeps a new number, skips protection, and continues with the pre-selected home internet plan through promotions and add-ons
steps.expected: [BE] The line-2 offers request carries ispCategoryList from the eligibility response; line 1's handset plan is untouched. [Both] configure-plan/promotions/addons complete; create-subscriber confirm → "Continue to order summary".

steps.action: Rep reviews the shared Order Summary
steps.expected: [FE] Order Summary loads without error — Lines in order = 2, both the handset and the home internet line listed with their own pricing; Total MRC covers both.

steps.action: Rep passes through Add Accessory (adding none) and collects the exact total in cash
steps.expected: [FE] "Review invoice" balance covers both lines. [Both] Single cash payment completes the order. [BE] SaleRecord persists with a real record number (no 'TEMP-').

test_cases.name: Home internet eligibility falls back to the account number when identity validation is skipped
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
Mid-new-account flow there is no activated MDN yet, so the eligibility check cannot rely on one. RTPL-2630 introduced a fallback identifier chain matching legacy POS: IDV-captured phone → line-assigned number in the cart → account number (BAN). Before the fix, every new-account HINT activation with no usable phone errored at the eligibility step. When identity validation is deliberately skipped and no line carries a number, the BAN must be used — the eligibility call still succeeds.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2630 (identifier fallback chain — release-blocking), RTPL-2397 (unblocker)

## Preconditions
- enable_subscriber_activation_hint ON.
- New account created with identity validation SKIPPED (no IDV phone captured); the HINT gateway is the first line — no voice line exists, so no cart MDN either.

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **HINT gateway IMEI:** 999977129737997 (backend-mock: 390100000000101)
- **Eligible service address:** 31455 NORTHWESTERN HWY, FARMINGTON, MI 48334 (backend-mock ZIP 33101)

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- Legacy parity: BAN is padded PADR(BAN,10,'0') on the legacy side; assert the request fired and succeeded rather than the exact identifier formatting.
- The mock's 409 path is driven by a line flag (IMEI 390170900000001), not by the ZIP — use that IMEI only for the negative sibling case.

steps.action: Rep enters the HINT gateway IMEI and confirms the home internet device
steps.expected: [BE] validate-device classifies HomeInternet. [FE] Address eligibility panel opens.

steps.action: Rep submits the eligible service address
steps.expected: [Both] 'provide-hint-address' returns 200 'hint-consent-required' — the eligibility request used the account number (BAN) as the identifier since no IDV phone and no cart MDN exist. NO 'hint-account-mdn-unavailable' error. [FE] Acknowledgement drawer opens.

steps.action: Rep accepts both acknowledgements and continues
steps.expected: [Both] 'accept-hint-consent' advances to validate-sim-card. [FE] SIM validation header appears.

test_cases.name: Offer only home internet plans that match the address's eligibility tier
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
Metro filters home internet plans by the ispCategoryList sent on the offers request; the category comes from the eligibility response for the submitted service address and is persisted on the line (HintPlanCategory). Before RTPL-2405 the category was never forwarded, so Metro returned an empty plan list and every HINT activation dead-ended at plan selection. Per RTPL-2648, an Unlimited-eligible address must see only Unlimited plans and a capped/Lite-eligible address only data-capped plans — selling the wrong tier is a provisioning failure at install.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2405 (empty plan list — fixed by forwarding the category), RTPL-2648 (tier filtering ACs), RTPL-2008 (Epic)

## Preconditions
- enable_subscriber_activation_hint ON.
- HINT activation advanced through an ELIGIBLE address + accepted acknowledgements + SIM; rep is about to reach Plan selection.

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **HINT gateway IMEI:** 999977129737997 (backend-mock: 390100000000101)
- **Unlimited-tier service address:** 31455 NORTHWESTERN HWY, FARMINGTON, MI 48334 (unlimited tier)

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- The category is injected at fetch-offers for BOTH new-subscriber and existing-subscriber (add-a-line) paths — cover the add-a-line variant when the harness supports it.
- Non-HINT lines must send ispCategoryList = null — assert on a handset line in the same run (cross-contamination was an explicit RTPL-2405 AC).
- Empty plan list at this step = RTPL-2405 regression; file, don't retry.

steps.action: Rep advances from Protection selection to Plan selection
steps.expected: [BE] GET selection-options/plans → the upstream offers request carries ispCategoryList = [category captured at eligibility] (e.g. 'unlimited'); it is never null and never an empty-string entry for a HINT line. [FE] Plan selection header; plan list is NON-EMPTY and every card is a Home Internet plan of the matching tier; index 0 pre-selected.

steps.action: Rep selects the pre-selected plan and continues
steps.expected: [Both] POST configure-plan succeeds; GET selection-options/promotions. [FE] Cart gains Plan (SOC) = $x / mo.; Estimated monthly and Total due update.

test_cases.name: Treat a Home Internet Lite / capped-only address as not eligible for the unlimited gateway sale
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
Legacy POS forces NOT-eligible when the eligibility response is category 'capped' or the message contains "Home Internet Lite is available" — the store must not sell an Unlimited home internet gateway at an address that only qualifies for Lite. The RT Go frontend only reacts to the hint-address-not-eligible reason code, so the backend mapping (RTPL-1889) must translate capped/Lite verdicts into that code. If it doesn't, reps sell Unlimited HINT at Lite-only addresses — the top parity-gap risk called out in the RTPL-2289 analysis.

## Related tickets
RTPL-1889 (BE capped/Lite mapping — flagged highest parity-gap risk), RTPL-2289 (parity analysis), RTPL-2648 (AC-3)

## Preconditions
- enable_subscriber_activation_hint ON.
- HINT activation at the address eligibility form (device confirmed).

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **HINT gateway IMEI:** 999977129737997 (backend-mock: 390170400000001 = limited-tier switch, or ZIP 33103)
- **Lite/capped-tier service address:** 500 MAIN ST, SPRINGFIELD, IL 62701 (known Lite-tier reference; backend-mock ZIP 33103)

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- If the acknowledgement drawer opens for a capped/Lite address, that is the RTPL-1889 mapping failure — file P1 immediately (rep would sell Unlimited at a Lite-only address).
- Mock limited-tier: IMEI 390170400000001 or ZIP 33103 both land on hint-address-not-eligible.

steps.action: Rep submits the Lite/capped-tier service address
steps.expected: [Both] The eligibility response carries the capped category / Lite message, and the platform returns reasonCode 'hint-address-not-eligible' — NOT 'hint-consent-required'. [FE] Dialog "Address not eligible" appears; the acknowledgement drawer must NOT open.

steps.action: Rep clicks "Try a different address"
steps.expected: [Both] 'retry-hint-address' resets the stage. [FE] Address form reopens for a corrected address; flow not cancelled.

test_cases.name: Keep the rep's entered address and offer retry when the eligibility service fails
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
When the HomeInternetEligibilityCheck service times out or errors, the activation must not silently dead-end and must not throw away the address the rep typed. The platform surfaces a service error (503 service-unavailable) and the rep retries the SAME address without re-entering it. Losing the address on error extends in-store time and risks a mistyped address being saved on the account.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2289 (AC-10 — retry without losing the address), RTPL-2678 (surfacing service reason codes)

## Preconditions
- enable_subscriber_activation_hint ON.
- HINT activation at the address eligibility form (device confirmed).

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **HINT gateway IMEI:** backend-mock: 390170500000001 (service error) / 390170600000001 (timeout); live: any HINT IMEI with fault injection
- **Valid service address:** 789 OAK AVE, DALLAS, TX 75201 (backend-mock ZIP switch 33104 = service error)

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- AC-10 also asked for an explicit retry CTA — the RTPL-2289 analysis found only the generic widget error handler; if no dedicated retry control exists, assert recovery via re-Continue and note the CTA gap.
- Toast errors auto-dismiss — assert on the network response + toast in the same tick.

steps.action: Rep enters the valid service address and clicks Continue while the eligibility service is failing
steps.expected: [Both] 'provide-hint-address' returns 503 with code 'service-unavailable'. [FE] The loading state closes and a service error is surfaced (top-right toast — capture it synchronously on the 503); the flow is NOT cancelled and the acknowledgement drawer does NOT open.

steps.action: Rep re-opens/inspects the address form
steps.expected: [FE] Every previously entered field (address line 1/2, city, state, ZIP) still holds the rep's values — nothing was cleared.

steps.action: Rep clicks Continue again once the service is healthy
steps.expected: [Both] The same address resubmits and returns 200 'hint-consent-required'. [FE] Acknowledgement drawer opens — recovery complete without re-entry.

test_cases.name: Validate the service-address form: field limits, ZIP auto-fill, and a rejected invalid address
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
The service address drives a real eligibility verdict, so the form constrains input before submission: address line 1 requires 2-30 characters, line 2 allows up to 15, city up to 40 (all forced UPPERCASE), state is a US-state select, and ZIP is a 5-digit numeric mask that auto-resolves city/state. An address the validator rejects returns invalid-hint-address without burning an eligibility check. The 15-char line-2 cap is tighter than legacy POS — multi-unit designators that truncate can produce false not-eligible verdicts.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2289 (address form spec: 2-30 / 0-15 / 40 / select / 99999)

## Preconditions
- enable_subscriber_activation_hint ON.
- HINT activation at the address eligibility form (device confirmed).

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **HINT gateway IMEI:** 999977129737997 (backend-mock: 390100000000101)
- **Unvalidatable address:** Any address with backend-mock ZIP 00000 (mock returns 400 invalid-hint-address); live: an address the validator rejects

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- Missing required fields also return 400 invalid-hint-address with message "address, zipCode, city, and state are required for provide-hint-address." (mock) — cover via API-level assertion if the UI blocks submission first.
- The 15-char line-2 cap vs legacy unbounded is a known parity note — flag truncation-induced false ineligibles as product feedback, not test failure.

steps.action: Rep types a single character into address line 1 and moves focus away
steps.expected: [FE] Validation error on address line 1 (minimum 2 characters); Continue disabled. Input is forced UPPERCASE.

steps.action: Rep attempts to type beyond each field's limit
steps.expected: [FE] Input truncates/stops at 30 / 15 / 40 characters respectively; no client-side crash.

steps.action: Rep types letters into the ZIP field
steps.expected: [FE] ZIP mask (99999) rejects non-numeric input; field stays empty/partial.

steps.action: Rep types a valid covered-market ZIP
steps.expected: [FE] City and state auto-populate (city UPPERCASE, state code); fields disabled during lookup, editable after.

steps.action: Rep submits an address the validator cannot validate
steps.expected: [Both] 'provide-hint-address' returns 400 'invalid-hint-address' ("The provided address could not be validated."). [FE] Error surfaced (toast); form values retained; NO eligibility verdict dialog and NO acknowledgement drawer.

test_cases.name: Block the home internet line with a clear conflict when the account has no usable identifier
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
The eligibility check needs some account identifier (IDV phone → cart MDN → BAN). When none exists anywhere — e.g. an authenticated account whose primary MDN is unavailable and no fallback resolves — the platform returns a 409 Conflict with reason code hint-account-mdn-unavailable. This is terminal for the HINT line (it fires before the address is even checked) and must surface clearly instead of a silent failure.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2630 (identifier chain — error when nothing exists), RTPL-1889 (BE eligibility)

## Preconditions
- enable_subscriber_activation_hint ON.
- HINT activation at the address eligibility form using the identifier-unavailable data switch.

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **HINT gateway IMEI:** 390170900000001 (backend-mock account-MDN-unavailable switch; live equivalent requires an account with no resolvable identifier)
- **Any valid service address:** 31455 NORTHWESTERN HWY, FARMINGTON, MI 48334

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- 409 ≠ address problem: assert the distinction — 'hint-account-mdn-unavailable' must NOT render the RTPL-2565 address dialog.
- Mock switch is the line flag set by the IMEI, not the ZIP.

steps.action: Rep submits a valid service address on the flagged line
steps.expected: [Both] 'provide-hint-address' returns 409 Conflict with reasonCode 'hint-account-mdn-unavailable' — returned BEFORE any address validation or eligibility call. [FE] Error surfaced to the rep (toast — capture synchronously); the acknowledgement drawer does NOT open; the address is not treated as ineligible (no "Address not eligible" dialog).

test_cases.name: Back out of the home internet acknowledgement and cancel the line cleanly
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
On the dual acknowledgement drawer the rep can decline/back out instead of accepting. The shipped frontend maps decline to cancel-line (the backend's decline-hint-consent action exists but is not wired to the UI). The original AC-9 asked Back to return to device validation; the code cancels the line — a documented discrepancy. This case pins the shipped behavior so any future change is a conscious one, and verifies cancellation is clean (no orphaned HINT state).

## Related tickets
RTPL-2289 (AC-9 back-navigation discrepancy), RTPL-2008 (Epic)

## Preconditions
- enable_subscriber_activation_hint ON.
- HINT activation with an ELIGIBLE address submitted; the "Home internet acknowledgement" drawer is open; acknowledgements NOT yet accepted.

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **HINT gateway IMEI:** 999977129737997 (backend-mock: 390100000000101)
- **Eligible service address:** 31455 NORTHWESTERN HWY, FARMINGTON, MI 48334 (backend-mock ZIP 33101)

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- Documented discrepancy: AC-9 wanted Back → device validation; shipped code sends CANCEL_LINE. This case asserts the shipped behavior — if product later fixes AC-9, update this case deliberately.
- decline-hint-consent exists API-side and throws ValidationAbortedException — API-level coverage can hit it directly; the UI never sends it.

steps.action: Rep dismisses/declines the acknowledgement drawer without accepting
steps.expected: [Both] The frontend executes cancel-line (NOT decline-hint-consent). [FE] The HINT line is removed from the order; the drawer closes; the rep lands on the flow's cancel-line destination (add-line/device entry) with no HINT breadcrumb remaining.

steps.action: Rep starts a fresh line with the same HINT gateway IMEI
steps.expected: [Both] validate-device succeeds again — the cancelled line left no lock on the IMEI. [FE] "Confirm home internet device" drawer opens fresh; the address form is EMPTY (no residue from the cancelled line).

test_cases.name: Reject a home internet gateway with the unsupported-device dialog when the feature flag is off
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
HINT is gated by the ConfigCat flag enable_subscriber_activation_hint (default false; backend-mock: subscriber_activation_hint_enabled). With the flag OFF, entering a gateway IMEI must fail device validation with UnsupportedDeviceTypeException('HINT') and the standard unsupported-device dialog — the rep is steered to RTPOS instead of a half-working flow. With the flag ON the same IMEI proceeds to the HINT step. Flag handling must fail closed.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2398 (flag gating), RTPL-2008 (Epic)

## Preconditions
- ConfigCat flag enable_subscriber_activation_hint OFF for the store.
- New activation at IMEI validation.

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **HINT gateway IMEI:** 999977129737997 (backend-mock: 390100000000101 with subscriber_activation_hint_enabled=false)

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- Backend reads the flag with default FALSE — an unset flag must behave as OFF (fail closed); cover by clearing the override, not just setting false.
- Frontend has NO hint feature flag — the gate is entirely backend; don't hunt for an FE flag fixture.

steps.action: Rep enters the HINT gateway IMEI with the flag OFF
steps.expected: [Both] validate-device returns the unsupported-device-type outcome (UnsupportedDeviceTypeException 'HINT'). [FE] The unsupported-device dialog appears ("Device not supported / use RTPOS" pattern); the flow does NOT advance to the HINT confirm-device drawer.

steps.action: Toggle the flag ON and rep re-enters the same IMEI on a fresh line
steps.expected: [Both] validate-device now classifies HomeInternet. [FE] "Confirm home internet device" drawer opens — flag ON restores the flow.

test_cases.name: Keep standard handset activations free of any home internet step or labels
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
The HINT step must be invisible to every non-HINT activation. RTPL-2398 shipped after the HINT eligibility step appeared for standard handsets regardless of flag state; the fix auto-skips hint-validate for non-HINT devices (shouldSkipHintValidation nulls the active step when a non-HINT device would land on HINT_VALIDATE). A regression here blocks every handset activation in the store, not just home internet.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2398 (HINT step leaked into non-HINT activations — fixed by auto-skip), RTPL-2289 (TC-7 regression guard)

## Preconditions
- enable_subscriber_activation_hint ON (the leak must not depend on the flag).
- New account created and ID verified.

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **Phone IMEI:** First unused IMEI from the env fixture pool (singleSims)
- **SIM (ICCID):** Matching pooled ICCID

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- Assert the ABSENCE of validate-hint network calls for the whole run — presence is the RTPL-2398 regression even if the UI happens to skip.
- Risk from the ticket: an unexpected backend device-type label could mis-route a phone into the HINT step — treat any HINT artifact as P1.

steps.action: Rep enters the standard phone IMEI
steps.expected: [BE] validate-device classifies a phone (not HomeInternet); zero calls to the validate-hint activity. [FE] NO "Confirm home internet device" drawer — flow routes to the phone's normal next step.

steps.action: Rep completes SIM validation and walks the flow through plan selection
steps.expected: [FE] At no point does the "Home internet address eligibility" panel, the "HINT Eligibility" breadcrumb, or the "Home internet eligibility" cart chip appear. [BE] The offers request for the phone line carries ispCategoryList = null.

steps.action: Rep reviews the Order Summary
steps.expected: [FE] No home-internet section or label anywhere in Order Summary; the flow never stalled on a hidden HINT step.

test_cases.name: Push the home internet offer to the customer tablet during bill-pay only for fully eligible addresses
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## Feature description
During a standalone bill payment, when the customer's service address qualifies for FULL Home Internet Unlimited, the platform auto-pushes a promo message to the customer-facing VSA tablet at invoice approval: "Congratulations! Your home address qualifies for High Speed Internet Unlimited!" with the $50/mo AutoPay pitch (Spanish variant included). It fires best-effort — a failure logs a warning and never blocks the payment. Capped/Lite verdicts and missing address/MDN data suppress it, and activation payments never trigger it. The tablet auto-dismisses the message after 60 seconds.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2434 (VSA HINT bill-pay message), RTPL-2625 (moved to invoice approval), RTPL-2760 (device-eligibility mock switch)

## Preconditions
- Store has a paired VSA tablet (VsaTerminalId present); VSA flag ON.
- Existing account with a payable balance whose billing address is FULL-unlimited eligible; a second account whose address is capped/Lite.

## Test Data (FE — what the rep types)
- **Unlimited-eligible account:** Billing address ZIP 48334 (Farmington MI — proxy mock: unlimited); MDN present on the bill-pay request
- **Capped/Lite account:** Billing address ZIP 36310 (proxy mock: capped — message suppressed)

_All other values (device type, MDN, plan, coupon, protection, add-on) are discovered at run time — not pinned._

## Automation Notes
- Tablet-side assertion needs the Appium/uiautomator2 harness (VSA forms auto-dismiss — start the waiter before invoice approval).
- RTPL-2625 moved the trigger from LookupBillingAccount to ConfirmInvoice so the invoice owns the tablet first — asserting the message BEFORE invoice approval is a false failure.
- RTPL-2760 added the device-eligibility mock switch to test controls — use it to force verdicts on QA.
- Strings are hard-coded in the backend (legacy vsaapi.prg parity), not i18n — assert verbatim.

steps.action: Rep runs a standalone bill payment for the unlimited-eligible account and approves the invoice
steps.expected: [BE] At invoice approval (ConfirmInvoice — not account lookup) the eligibility check runs with the request MDN + full billing address; verdict Eligible + non-empty eligibilityId + category != 'capped' + message without "Home Internet Lite is available". [FE-tablet] VSA tablet displays title "Congratulations! Your home address qualifies for High Speed Internet Unlimited!" and message starting "I just wanted to let you know that we are offering Home Internet! Plans start at just $50 a month with AutoPay"; no header row; auto-dismisses after ~60 seconds.

steps.action: Rep completes the cash payment on the POS while the tablet shows (or has dismissed) the message
steps.expected: [Both] Payment completes normally — the HINT push never blocks or delays the payment flow.

steps.action: Rep runs a standalone bill payment for the capped/Lite account and approves the invoice
steps.expected: [BE] Eligibility verdict is capped/Lite → suppressed. [FE-tablet] NO HINT message appears; the tablet returns to/stays on its home screen.
